## get_status

Project root, configured providers and their capabilities, Blender detection, budget summary and setup steps still needed. Call this first.

_No arguments._

## get_budget

Spend summary (committed, reserved, unknown-outcome) against limits, plus recent ledger entries. Amounts are local estimates unless the provider reported usage.

| Argument | Type    | Required | Description |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `recent` | integer |          |             |

## generate_image

Text-to-image for any use: app icons, UI art, illustrations, textures, references. Saves into the project (outputDir, or assets/<category>/<collection>/references/) and records metadata. Identical requests are served from cache at no cost. Billable: uses the configured provider with the user's API key. Estimates cost first; respects project budget. Use dryRun to quote.

| Argument         | Type            | Required         | Description                                                                                                                 |
| ---------------- | --------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`         | string          | yes              |                                                                                                                             |
| `collection`     | string          | yes              | Asset collection name, e.g. "pip-the-cat". Files go to assets/<category>/<collection>/.                                     |
| `category`       | `"characters"`  | `"environments"` | `"props"`                                                                                                                   | `"textures"` | `"videos"`                                                                                                                                                        | `"ui"`          | `"misc"` |     | Asset category directory (default depends on tool). |
| `role`           | string          |                  | Short label used in the filename, e.g. "concept".                                                                           |
| `model`          | string          |                  |                                                                                                                             |
| `provider`       | string          |                  | Image provider id (see get_status). Default: openai.                                                                        |
| `size`           | string          |                  | "1024x1024" (default), "1536x1024", "1024x1536", "auto", or custom WxH on supported models.                                 |
| `quality`        | `"low"`         | `"medium"`       | `"high"`                                                                                                                    | `"auto"`     |                                                                                                                                                                   | Default medium. |
| `background`     | `"transparent"` | `"opaque"`       | `"auto"`                                                                                                                    |              | "transparent" returns a PNG with real transparency. Providers that cannot do it natively (Gemini) generate on a flat backdrop and the subject is cut out locally. |
| `outputFormat`   | `"png"`         | `"webp"`         | `"jpeg"`                                                                                                                    |              |                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `outputDir`      | string          |                  | Project-relative folder to save into, e.g. "src/assets/icons" or "public/images". Default: assets/<category>/<collection>/. |
| `fileName`       | string          |                  | File name without extension, e.g. "dumbbell-icon". Never overwrites: "-2" is added if it exists.                            |
| `trim`           | boolean         |                  | With a transparent background: crop to the subject (8 px padding).                                                          |
| `n`              | integer         |                  |                                                                                                                             |
| `bypassCache`    | boolean         |                  | Generate even if an identical request is cached.                                                                            |
| `dryRun`         | boolean         |                  | Return the cost estimate without generating anything.                                                                       |
| `confirmCostUsd` | number          |                  | Required when the estimate exceeds the approval threshold. Only pass after the user approved this amount.                   |

## generate_character_turnaround

Generates character reference views for 3D modelling: a front view (from text, or derived from an approved conceptImage), then side/back/three-quarter views conditioned on the front view. Quotes the whole sheet up front. Views are visual references and are not guaranteed to be geometrically consistent; review them. Billable: uses the configured provider with the user's API key. Estimates cost first; respects project budget. Use dryRun to quote.

| Argument         | Type            | Required   | Description                                                                             |
| ---------------- | --------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `collection`     | string          | yes        | Asset collection name, e.g. "pip-the-cat". Files go to assets/<category>/<collection>/. |
| `description`    | string          | yes        | What the character looks like. Describe an original character.                          |
| `style`          | string          |            | e.g. "stylised low-poly cartoon, soft colours".                                         |
| `views`          | `"front"`       | `"side"`   | `"back"`                                                                                | `"three_quarter"`[] |                                                                                                                                                                   | Default front, side, back. |
| `conceptImage`   | string          |            | Approved concept to stay consistent with.                                               |
| `model`          | string          |            |                                                                                         |
| `provider`       | string          |            |                                                                                         |
| `quality`        | `"low"`         | `"medium"` | `"high"`                                                                                | `"auto"`            |                                                                                                                                                                   | Default medium.            |
| `size`           | string          |            | Default 1024x1536 (portrait, full body).                                                |
| `background`     | `"transparent"` | `"opaque"` | `"auto"`                                                                                |                     | "transparent" returns a PNG with real transparency. Providers that cannot do it natively (Gemini) generate on a flat backdrop and the subject is cut out locally. |
| `bypassCache`    | boolean         |            | Generate even if an identical request is cached.                                        |
| `dryRun`         | boolean         |            | Return the cost estimate without generating anything.                                   |
| `confirmCostUsd` | number          |            | Approval for the TOTAL sheet estimate.                                                  |

## remove_background

Makes the flat background of an existing image transparent and saves a PNG. Works best on icons, sprites and objects on a plain solid background; not suited to photos or busy backgrounds. Runs locally, no API call.

| Argument         | Type           | Required         | Description                                                                                                                 |
| ---------------- | -------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `image`          | string         | yes              | Asset id (ast_…) or a path inside the project.                                                                              |
| `outputDir`      | string         |                  | Project-relative folder to save into, e.g. "src/assets/icons" or "public/images". Default: assets/<category>/<collection>/. |
| `fileName`       | string         |                  | File name without extension, e.g. "dumbbell-icon". Never overwrites: "-2" is added if it exists.                            |
| `trim`           | boolean        |                  | With a transparent background: crop to the subject (8 px padding).                                                          |
| `padding`        | integer        |                  | Padding in pixels when trimming. Default 8.                                                                                 |
| `tolerance`      | number         |                  | How far a colour may differ from the background and still be removed. Default 40.                                           |
| `softness`       | number         |                  | Width of the soft edge. Default 40.                                                                                         |
| `removeEnclosed` | boolean        |                  | Also clear background-coloured areas not connected to the edge (e.g. holes).                                                |
| `collection`     | string         |                  | Asset collection name, e.g. "pip-the-cat". Files go to assets/<category>/<collection>/.                                     |
| `category`       | `"characters"` | `"environments"` | `"props"`                                                                                                                   | `"textures"` | `"videos"` | `"ui"` | `"misc"` |     | Asset category directory (default depends on tool). |

## generate_video

Submits a text- or image-to-video job (default: Gemini Omni Flash, 3-15 s, 360p/720p/1080p/4k, 16:9 or 9:16, up to 6 reference images) and returns a job id immediately; poll get_job. Job state persists across server restarts. Generated video is a motion reference, not a skeletal animation. Billable: uses the configured provider with the user's API key. Estimates cost first; respects project budget. Use dryRun to quote.

| Argument          | Type           | Required         | Description                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------- | -------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`          | string         | yes              |                                                                                                                             |
| `collection`      | string         | yes              | Asset collection name, e.g. "pip-the-cat". Files go to assets/<category>/<collection>/.                                     |
| `category`        | `"characters"` | `"environments"` | `"props"`                                                                                                                   | `"textures"`  | `"videos"` | `"ui"`        | `"misc"` |     | Asset category directory (default depends on tool). |
| `images`          | string[]       |                  | Reference or start-frame images (character consistency, image-to-video).                                                    |
| `durationSeconds` | integer        |                  | Default 8.                                                                                                                  |
| `resolution`      | `"360p"`       | `"720p"`         | `"1080p"`                                                                                                                   | `"4k"`        |            | Default 720p. |
| `aspectRatio`     | `"16:9"`       | `"9:16"`         |                                                                                                                             | Default 16:9. |
| `model`           | string         |                  | See get_status for available video models.                                                                                  |
| `outputDir`       | string         |                  | Project-relative folder to save into, e.g. "src/assets/icons" or "public/images". Default: assets/<category>/<collection>/. |
| `fileName`        | string         |                  | File name without extension, e.g. "dumbbell-icon". Never overwrites: "-2" is added if it exists.                            |
| `provider`        | string         |                  |                                                                                                                             |
| `bypassCache`     | boolean        |                  | Generate even if an identical request is cached.                                                                            |
| `dryRun`          | boolean        |                  | Return the cost estimate without generating anything.                                                                       |
| `confirmCostUsd`  | number         |                  | Required when the estimate exceeds the approval threshold. Only pass after the user approved this amount.                   |

## generate_3d_from_image

Submits an image-to-3D reconstruction job and returns a job id; poll get_job. Results usually need cleanup (retopology, decimation, UVs) before game use; run validate_3d_asset on the output. Billable: uses the configured provider with the user's API key. Estimates cost first; respects project budget. Use dryRun to quote.

| Argument         | Type           | Required         | Description                                                                                               |
| ---------------- | -------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `image`          | string         | yes              | Asset id (ast_…) or a path inside the project.                                                            |
| `collection`     | string         | yes              | Asset collection name, e.g. "pip-the-cat". Files go to assets/<category>/<collection>/.                   |
| `category`       | `"characters"` | `"environments"` | `"props"`                                                                                                 | `"textures"` | `"videos"` | `"ui"` | `"misc"` |     | Asset category directory (default depends on tool). |
| `prompt`         | string         |                  |                                                                                                           |
| `model`          | string         |                  |                                                                                                           |
| `provider`       | string         |                  |                                                                                                           |
| `bypassCache`    | boolean        |                  | Generate even if an identical request is cached.                                                          |
| `dryRun`         | boolean        |                  | Return the cost estimate without generating anything.                                                     |
| `confirmCostUsd` | number         |                  | Required when the estimate exceeds the approval threshold. Only pass after the user approved this amount. |

## get_job

Polls the provider for a video or 3D job. When complete, downloads outputs into the project and registers them (download: false to only check status).

| Argument   | Type    | Required | Description |
| ---------- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `jobId`    | string  | yes      |             |
| `download` | boolean |          |             |

## cancel_job

Cancels a queued job (not billed). A job that is already running may only receive a cancellation request and can still complete and be billed.

| Argument | Type   | Required | Description |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `jobId`  | string | yes      |             |

## get_model_spec_guide

Schema, conventions and a worked example for the declarative model spec used by build_blender_model. Read this before writing a spec.

_No arguments._

## build_blender_model

Builds a new model version in headless Blender from a declarative JSON spec (primitives, transforms, modifiers, materials; no Python). Optionally places reference images as planes (front/side/back) for later manual work. Saves a versioned spec + .blend, keeps previous versions, and returns scene stats and a Roblox pre-import report. Call get_model_spec_guide first. Free (local), but each call creates a version and versions per collection are capped.

| Argument     | Type           | Required         | Description                                                                             |
| ------------ | -------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `collection` | string         | yes              | Asset collection name, e.g. "pip-the-cat". Files go to assets/<category>/<collection>/. |
| `category`   | `"characters"` | `"environments"` | `"props"`                                                                               | `"textures"` | `"videos"` | `"ui"` | `"misc"` |     | Asset category directory (default depends on tool). |
| `spec`       | object         | yes              | Model spec object (see get_model_spec_guide).                                           |
| `references` | object[]       |                  |                                                                                         |
| `note`       | string         |                  | What changed in this version and why.                                                   |

## render_model_previews

Renders preview images of a built model (default front, side, three_quarter at 512px, Workbench engine) and returns them as images, together with downscaled reference images when the model has references, so you can compare them and refine the spec.

| Argument            | Type          | Required  | Description                                 |
| ------------------- | ------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `blendAssetId`      | string        | yes       |                                             |
| `views`             | `"front"`     | `"side"`  | `"back"`                                    | `"three_quarter"` | `"top"`[] |     |     |
| `resolution`        | integer       |           |                                             |
| `engine`            | `"workbench"` | `"eevee"` | `"cycles"`                                  |                   |           |
| `transparent`       | boolean       |           |                                             |
| `includeReferences` | boolean       |           | Default true.                               |
| `returnImages`      | boolean       |           | Default true. Set false to only save files. |

## inspect_3d_asset

Scene statistics for a .blend, .glb, .gltf, .fbx or .obj (asset id or project path): objects, triangle counts after modifiers, materials, bounds, UVs, non-manifold edges, armatures.

| Argument | Type   | Required | Description               |
| -------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `target` | string | yes      | Asset id or project path. |

## validate_3d_asset

Checks a 3D file against an engine profile (currently "roblox": per-mesh triangle cap, size in studs, materials, UVs, rig). Passing does not guarantee a clean import; verify in Studio.

| Argument  | Type       | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target`  | string     | yes      |             |
| `profile` | `"roblox"` |          |             |

## export_3d_asset

Exports a built model (.blend asset) to glb/gltf/fbx/obj, re-imports each file in a clean Blender scene to verify it, and returns a Roblox pre-import report. Does not upload or publish anything.

| Argument         | Type    | Required | Description |
| ---------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `blendAssetId`   | string  | yes      |             |
| `formats`        | `"glb"` | `"gltf"` | `"fbx"`     | `"obj"`[] |     | Default ["glb"]. |
| `applyModifiers` | boolean |          |             |
